question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Woodcutting involves the removal of useless trees first. ______ by medium and finest quality timber trees.
solution:
The correct answer is '**followed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**followed**" is used to show a sequence or order of actions. (के बाद)
 
• The process of woodcutting involves the removal of useless trees first, which is then **followed** by the removal of medium and finest quality timber trees.
 
• The other options: "**adjusted**," "**enacted**," and "**compared**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Woodcutting involves the removal of useless trees first, followed__ by medium and finest quality timber trees.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjusted (समायोजित)**: means altered or modified slightly to achieve a desired fit or result.
 
• **Enacted (अधिनियमित)**: means to make a proposal or idea into a law.
 
• **Compared (तुलना की गई)**: means to estimate or measure similarities or differences between two or more things.
